data.one_liner: A customizable animated star rating bar widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides an interactive or read-only star-based rating widget with smooth animations. Allows customization of star colors, icons, sizes, animation duration, and curves.
use_when: You need a star rating input or display widget with animations.
You want to allow users to rate items using half-filled or full stars.
avoid_when: You need non-star based rating systems like sliders or numeric inputs.
You require complex form validation integrations handled natively.
strengths: Supports both interactive and read-only modes.
Includes built-in animations for rating changes.
weaknesses: Basic feature set without advanced forms or multi-criteria rating support.
